notes.title: The Plague Update
notes.notes:
After a successful launch, Team Countdown is happy to deliver the final update for Katharsi. We look forward to hearing your feedback on the updated environment and seeing you complete the achievements!

Changes we've made:

More plague everywhere!

Achievements

New sensors

Improved cutscenes

Updated credits

Bug fixing

Thank you for playing Katharsi, sharing your feedback and leaving your comments!
